title: Close Enough to Touch a Whale

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks an adult)

collection.description: Whales pass close to the reef, and a villager who longs to be near one wades in: paddle out gently, or watch from the rocks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Every year, a few whales pass along the coast, and every year (subject) watches them from the beach and wishes (subject.he/she) could be close, just once. This morning the whales are passing very near the reef, and (friend) has a canoe on the sand. (subject) is already wading in.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: They paddle out slowly and stop well back, then sit very still. One of the whales rises, close enough to hear it breathe, a long rushing sigh, and looks at them, or seems to. Then it sinks away without a ripple. (subject) doesn't say anything all the way back. (subject.He/she) doesn't need to.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) stops at the water's edge. "No," (subject.he/she) says. "Not too close. It's their sea." They climb onto the end of the rocks instead and watch the whales pass, closer than (subject) has ever seen them. A spout of mist drifts over them in the breeze. It smells of fish. (subject) has never been happier.
